title: Donald Trump Jr. & Pilot Family Lead $1.3 Million Private Placement for PSQ Holdings
summary: All Eligible Directors Participate in Private Placement Underscoring Confidence in Management, Strategy, and Execution PSQ Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: PSQH) (the “Company”), a payments and financial infrastructure company, today announced the closing of a private investment in public equity financing (the “Private Placement”), resulting in gross proceeds of approximately $1.3 million, before fees and expenses. Every eligible member of the Company’s Board of Directors participated in the Private Placement, investing personal capital at a premium to the most recent closing price of the Company’s Class A common stock. At closing, the Company issued an aggregate of 361,388 shares of Class A common stock at a price of $3.60 per share. No warrants, pre-funded warrants, or other derivative securities were included in the transaction.
